entities.name: Query protein 309 aa
observations: Sequence length is 309 aa; estimated molecular mass is 33.34 kDa.
Predicted theoretical pI is 4.91 with estimated net charge −12.2 at pH 7.
Pfam matches: PfkB family (PF00294.30; residues 1–295; i-Evalue 2e−67) and Phos_pyr_kin (PF08543.18; residues 168–278; i-Evalue 1.1e−12).
Best reviewed homologs are bacterial ribokinases with 36.8–39.3% identity and 96.4–97.7% query coverage.
Direct sequence evidence supports a soluble cytosolic ribokinase-family enzyme; exact substrate specificity remains inferred from homology.

entities.name: Ribokinase
observations: Reviewed bacterial ribokinase homologs catalyze ATP- and divalent-cation-dependent phosphorylation of D-ribose to D-ribose 5-phosphate.
Reference annotations specify EC 2.7.1.15, cytosolic localization, and homodimeric assembly.
Mg2+ is the likely physiological divalent cation; some homologs also use Mn2+.
Some bacterial ribokinases are activated by monovalent cations, especially K+.

entities.name: D-ribose phosphorylation
observations: D-ribose + ATP → D-ribose 5-phosphate + ADP + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:13697 and EC 2.7.1.15 in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: D-ribose catabolism
observations: Ribokinase activity supplies D-ribose 5-phosphate for nucleotide, histidine, and tryptophan biosynthesis and/or pentose-phosphate metabolism.
